title: A user who cannot view the Inventory list sees neither tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with the Parts department on with Part Sales open to it and every Part Library & Inventory box unticked, so user B cannot view the Inventory list.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
  • Use a second browser window (a private window) signed in as user B.
custom_steps:
1. In the second window, click Parts in the top bar.
  2. Type the address of the Inventory page (it ends /parts/inventory) in the address bar.
  3. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Parts left menu opens for user B with Part Sales in it, and it does not offer Inventory.

Step 2:

  • The address is typed.

Step 3:

  • The Inventory list does not open for user B: neither the Active nor the Inactive tab is shown.
